notes.title: 5/20 CHALLENGE
notes.content:
After beating Night 3, go into Custom night and turn everyone's difficulty up to 20. (the hardest difficulty). 
Runs must be played on Moderate difficulty or higher. 
Runs must be video recorded.

notes.title: Fixed TERRIBLE lag and crashes (hopefully)
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where opening and closing the doors rapidly while shining flashlight results in crazy crashing.
We highly recommend turning off fog effects if you encounter any lag.
Enjoy.


-APT
